integrity: The result is reconstructed from an explicit reduced Świątkowski complex. Boundary-square checks, finite-field ranks, and a primitive integral top-cycle certificate are replayable from the included artifacts. Literature coverage is reported with residual search risk rather than as a uniqueness certificate.
scientific_limitations: The finite-field Betti vectors are proved only over the fields with two and three elements; the integral result is only in degree three. No integral classification in degrees one or two and no formula for other particle numbers is claimed.
title: Three-particle homology of the Heawood graph
